DataListSpec.Name: Checkbox List Filter Data List
DataListSpec.Description: A data list that uses a checkbox list style filter
DataListSpec.Author: Styons Software

SPDataList.c:CreateProcedureSQL:
CREATE PROCEDURE USR_USP_DATALIST_CHECKBOXLISTFILTER ( @ADDRESSINCLUDECODE TINYINT = NULL ,@ADDRESSTYPECODES XML = NULL ) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON IF @ADDRESSINCLUDECODE = 1 BEGIN DECLARE @ADDRESSTYPECODEIDS TABLE ( ADDRESSTYPECODEID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER ) INSERT INTO @ADDRESSTYPECODEIDS SELECT T.c.value('(ADDRESSTYPECODEID)[1]','uniqueidentifier') from @ADDRESSTYPECODES.nodes('/ADDRESSTYPECODES/ITEM') T(c) where 1 = T.c.value('(ADDRESSTYPECODEINCLUDE)[1]','bit')
SELECT A.ADDRESSBLOCK AS ADDRESSBLOCK ,A.CITY AS CITY ,A.POSTCODE AS POSTCODE ,ATC.[DESCRIPTION] AS ADDRESSTYPECODEDESCRIPTION ,A.ID AS ADDRESSID FROM [ADDRESS] A LEFT JOIN ADDRESSTYPECODE ATC ON ATC.ID = A.ADDRESSTYPECODEID JOIN @ADDRESSTYPECODEIDS CBX ON CBX.ADDRESSTYPECODEID = A.ADDRESSTYPECODEID END ELSE BEGIN SELECT A.ADDRESSBLOCK AS ADDRESSBLOCK ,A.CITY AS CITY ,A.POSTCODE AS POSTCODE ,ATC.[DESCRIPTION] AS ADDRESSTYPECODEDESCRIPTION ,A.ID AS ADDRESSID FROM [ADDRESS] A LEFT JOIN ADDRESSTYPECODE ATC ON ATC.ID = A.ADDRESSTYPECODEID END END
